text: Whey is the only real protein. Everything else is a scam!
Let's put all three side by side.
Whey has the most research, and it digests fast.
Plant blends work almost as well, and suit vegans and lactose-intolerant people.
Yeast protein is the newest, and dairy-free, but has the least research.
Most important of all? Your daily total. About one point six grams per kilo of body weight. Save this.
